Coram : ALTAMAS KABIR*, MARKANDEY KATJU
A B Company Jaw: Auction sale of assets of liquidated com­ pany - After advertisement in well known newspapers having c wide circulation - Highest bid accepted and sale confirmed :..... Subsequent fresh offer by two companies at higher price - Recalling of order by High Court - Correctness of - Held: Not correct as there was nothing to show that there was fraud or collusion in auction - sale - Once D sale is confirmed, certain rights accrued in favour of auction - purchaser which could not be extinguished except in excep­ tional case such as fraud.
Decision Date : 12-08-2008 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 4992/2008 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
